description: List every registered project and AI process with its running state, port, PID, command, path and id. Projects are the user's permanent entries, started with start_project; AI processes are temporary ones created by run_process or workspace_run. Call this first: it gives you the ids the other tools take, and shows whether the user already has a project for the checkout you are working in. Also lists the tags already in use.
name: list_projects
title: List all projects
